comparison.objective: Press three colored cables into matching comb slots without crossings, versus remove four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Routing and forceful cable seating into slots versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, fracture regulation, withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All cables seated in matching uncrossed slots versus four tangs fractured and contained with no coil or shell damage. Numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve alignment and controlled contact force, cable seating does not test notch fracture or free-fragment containment.
